name: Formivect

current.title: Fusion add-in and native execution
current.detail: A local add-in executes short native Fusion API jobs through custom events on the application thread. Fusion can remain in the background.
current.limit: Fusion must remain open; one host serializes CAD work. This is not an independent headless CAD engine.

current.title: CLI and MCP tools
current.detail: A command-line interface and standard MCP connection expose 17 tools with typed arguments and asynchronous job results.
current.limit: A queued or running job is not a completed change.

current.title: Explicit document binding
current.detail: List open documents, create a new unsaved design and bind one project to one open document. Closed targets fail explicitly.
current.limit: Bindings and document handles reset with the add-in session; they are not durable revision IDs.

current.title: Geometry and parameter inspection
current.detail: Read component/body counts, timeline count, user parameter names/expressions/units, body volumes and bounding dimensions.
current.limit: Inspection describes the CAD model, not physical measurements.

current.title: Unit-aware parameter changes
current.detail: Change an existing user parameter with a Fusion expression after checking the expression against its unit.
current.limit: Dedicated constraint editing, hole-pattern and broader feature tools are not included.

current.title: Box and cylinder creation
current.detail: Create a named component containing a sketched and extruded box or cylinder using millimeter dimensions.
current.limit: Basic primitives are a limited typed modeling surface, not full CAD coverage.

current.title: Native and exchange exports
current.detail: Export F3D, STEP or STL to unique output locations; existing exports are preserved.
current.limit: F3D retains Fusion-native continuity. Exchange geometry does not promise native feature-history recovery.

current.title: Real viewport images
current.detail: Capture a 1280 x 960 PNG from the bound project, restore the prior camera/document and return the image through MCP.
current.limit: Images support visual review; exact dimensions and hidden geometry require structured checks.

current.title: Advanced Python and text commands
current.detail: Opt-in access can invoke additional exposed Fusion APIs through trusted Python or native commands. Used for a recorded 12-component modeling workflow.
current.limit: Full access is unsandboxed and can reach other documents/files; it does not create missing Fusion APIs.

current.title: Native workspace and onboarding
current.detail: A dark native HTML palette provides a project sidebar, Studio, Activity, Usage and Access views, plus a four-step first-use tutorial.

current.title: Project and build histories
current.detail: Local SQLite conversation records separate projects and builds, retain visible replies and allow history export.
current.limit: Build labels are conversation partitions; they are not CAD branches or a versioned geometry graph.

current.title: Steering inbox and progress
current.detail: Send requests, questions and updates to a project/build inbox; connected agents can read new messages and post visible outcomes.
current.limit: Inbox delivery requires polling. Linking a task is not automatic desktop chat dispatch.

current.title: Fair project scheduling
current.detail: Independent project queues interleave fairly. Agents can plan concurrently while native CAD jobs run one at a time.
current.limit: This is not parallel native editing or a multi-agent coordinator.

current.title: Interactive-command guard and restoration
current.detail: Jobs wait while a native interactive command is active; targeted work restores the previously active document when possible.
current.limit: Background operation is supported for short jobs; it does not promise an entirely invisible application.

current.title: Pause, resume, stop and cancel
current.detail: Project/global controls hold queues, resume scheduling or cancel queued work; individual queued jobs can also be cancelled.
current.limit: A running native operation finishes normally. Stop is not undo; Resume does not relaunch an agent.

current.title: Job outcomes and duplicate protection
current.detail: Activity records expose queue/running/success/failure states. Request IDs suppress duplicate submissions within the add-in session.
current.limit: Queued jobs expire after 120 seconds, including while paused. Failed mutations may leave partial changes; crash recovery is not established.

current.title: Per-project model and effort selection
current.detail: Save a provider, exact model and supported reasoning effort independently for each project. A running job keeps its original selection.
current.limit: Changing a preference affects the next run; existing linked tasks retain their own settings.

current.title: Live Codex model discovery
current.detail: Refresh the installed client catalog and available reasoning efforts; Windows catalog reads and native selection were verified.
current.limit: Catalog presence does not guarantee account entitlement or capacity for every model.

current.title: User-started agent runs
current.detail: Start a new bounded CLI run from the palette with a saved model and recent build context. Windows Codex inspection, images and replies were verified.
current.limit: Runs use provider allowances. Three-, five- and fifteen-minute limits bound time, not money; runs are not restart-resumable.

current.title: Run controls and visible records
current.detail: Retain model/effort, run state, visible replies, session reference and provider-reported usage. Pause/Stop ends managed inference at the next control check.
current.limit: Up to 20 recent build messages seed a new run. Completion means the provider finished, not that engineering acceptance passed.

current.title: Managed project targeting
current.detail: Managed MCP is pinned to its project, hides document creation/binding/global controls and rejects cross-project job lookup or cancellation.
current.limit: These interface limits do not sandbox full Fusion scripting.

current.title: External task linking
current.detail: Discover local Codex task records or save manual Claude references and copy project connection instructions.
current.limit: Existing tasks start or continue in their own client. A Claude Desktop URL does not expose Claude Code usage logs.

current.title: Claude connection and run adapters
current.detail: MCP registration paths cover Claude Desktop and Claude Code. The managed Claude Code launcher accepts an exact model ID.
current.limit: Claude Code was absent on the validation host; live Claude inference remains unverified.

current.title: Local model experiment
current.detail: A bounded text/tool loop can use an already-running local OpenAI-compatible model server with an exact model ID.
current.limit: No weights are included or downloaded; no real local model was tested, and viewport images are not supplied to this adapter.

current.title: Granular operation permissions
current.detail: Inspect/model/export permissions are configurable; advanced access is off by default. Queued work rechecks permission at execution.
current.limit: Revocation was verified; unrestricted scripting still carries the host user privileges.

current.title: Local storage and connection controls
current.detail: Settings, histories, optional traces and exports stay in local stores. MCP uses stdio; authenticated HTTP binds to loopback and rejects browser origins.
current.limit: Chosen provider runs receive their prompts, recent context and requested tool results under provider settings.

current.title: Usage visibility
current.detail: Show available Codex account windows and retained linked Codex/Claude Code session tokens for today and lifetime; missing values remain unknown.
current.limit: Account limits are shared. Session totals are not exact incremental Formivect billing, billed credits or a token-to-plan-percentage conversion.

current.title: Opt-in learning records
current.detail: Record local operation episodes only when enabled; review them as accepted/rejected with provenance and evidence.
current.limit: Recording is off by default and does not update model weights.

current.title: Reviewed dataset export
current.detail: Export eligible rights-approved human/licensed/local examples as train/validation JSONL and a manifest, split by entire projects.
current.limit: Closed-provider/unknown traces and mixed-provider projects are excluded. This is early corpus preparation, not complete data governance.

current.title: Portable personal preview
current.detail: Windows/Mac installer files, backup of an existing add-in, provider registration choices and preserved local history support personal testing.
current.limit: Windows installation/native use are verified; Mac native use and full Fusion restart are not. The unsigned application package remains privately distributed.

current.title: Free preview interface
current.detail: The personal preview has no Formivect account, payment screen or Python package dependencies.
current.limit: Fusion, Python and chosen provider access remain prerequisites. No public commercial price or unrestricted software license is announced.

potential.title: Standalone engineering application
potential.detail: Own workspace, native project representation, feature/assembly behavior, execution runtime and deployed model route for supported workflows.
potential.limit: Demonstrate useful work without launching Fusion or relying on an external AI service.

potential.title: Shared manual and agent editing
potential.detail: Use the same commands for direct manipulation and conversational edits, preserving editable history and design intent.
potential.limit: Show a second human edit can rebuild correctly after agent work.

potential.title: Selection, drawing, image and voice context
potential.detail: Attach requests to actual faces/features and coordinate frames; accept drawings, annotated images or voice context alongside exact references.
potential.limit: Resolve selection and units explicitly; do not infer hidden dimensions as known facts.

potential.title: Engineering conversation and teaching
potential.detail: Explain concepts, critique designs, explore mechanism alternatives and ask for consequential missing inputs while independent work can continue.
potential.limit: Evaluate useful clarification and checked explanations on representative tasks.

potential.title: Unified workspace views
potential.detail: Switch among 3D, assembly/feature trees, parameters, drawings, analysis, manufacturing, BOM, requirements and history without losing task context.
potential.limit: Build actual two-way connections to a versioned project model.

potential.title: Requirements and acceptance contracts
potential.detail: Track user requirements, assumptions, units, tolerances, materials, interfaces, objectives, priorities and acceptance evidence.
potential.limit: Keep supplied, measured, supplier, calculated and estimated values distinguishable.

potential.title: Project branches and alternatives
potential.detail: Compare revisions and alternative designs on mass, cost, constraints and manufacturing assumptions; merge reviewable change sets.
potential.limit: Implement revision guards and conflict handling, not just named chat histories.

potential.title: Editable parametric features
potential.detail: Add sketch dimensions/constraints, extrude/revolve/loft, holes, patterns, fillets and dependency-aware feature regeneration.
potential.limit: Prove rebuild and editability on unseen in-scope designs.

potential.title: Assembly relationships and motion
potential.detail: Represent parts/configurations/transforms/joints and assess degrees of freedom, interference and clearance across declared motion.
potential.limit: Validate assembly constraints and sampled motion; model checks do not establish real friction.

potential.title: Stable geometry references
potential.detail: Use feature-origin identity, semantic roles and geometric matching to preserve references through topology changes.
potential.limit: Fail visibly when remapping is ambiguous; identifiers alone do not solve topology.

potential.title: Native geometry and constraints
potential.detail: Operate a precise boundary-representation kernel and constraint solvers with derived display meshes.
potential.limit: Kernel licensing/development, feature behavior and persistence require separate validation.

potential.title: Import, exchange and repair
potential.detail: Report imported units, hierarchy, metadata, repairs and missing history; support geometry exchange and explicitly inferred feature recovery.
potential.limit: Quantify translation losses. Proprietary translators and native formats remain feasibility work.

potential.title: Mesh, scan and reconstruction workflows
potential.detail: Allow mesh/scan data and image-based design interpretation alongside exact CAD, with visible precision and editability differences.
potential.limit: Treat reconstructed hidden geometry and unknown scale as inference, not measured truth.

potential.title: Engineering drawings and BOMs
potential.detail: Generate revision-linked views, dimensions, datums, tolerances, notes, quantities and configurations with source-dated purchased-part data.
potential.limit: Validate drawings/BOM completeness and their input revision.

potential.title: Analytical and numerical simulation
potential.detail: Connect equations, meshing and solver workers for supported structural/FEA, thermal, fluid/CFD or other declared analysis classes.
potential.limit: Each class needs validated loads, restraints, material models, convergence checks and benchmarks; coverage is not selected.

potential.title: Manufacturing and CAM preparation
potential.detail: Plan stock, tools/holders, fixtures, setups, operation sequences and postprocessed toolpaths; check process-specific limits and tool reach.
potential.limit: Qualify each process/machine route separately. Toolpath generation does not authorize machine execution.

potential.title: Evidence-linked verification
potential.detail: Connect requirements to data/unit checks, CAD integrity, assembly checks, analytical/numerical results, manufacturing review and physical tests.
potential.limit: Show methods, scope and limitations instead of one generic confidence score.

potential.title: Change impact and stale-result detection
potential.detail: Trace which edits invalidate downstream drawings, analyses, BOM entries, purchased interfaces and toolpaths.
potential.limit: Recompute affected evidence or demonstrate that it is unaffected.

potential.title: Physical test feedback
potential.detail: Attach procedures, instruments, calibration and measured results to the as-built configuration; compare actual outcomes with predictions.
potential.limit: Digital model success remains separate from physical qualification.

potential.title: Reusable engineering libraries
potential.detail: Store approved components, interfaces, material references and organizational practices with source/revision metadata.
potential.limit: Reusing a part does not automatically reuse the validity of an old load case.

potential.title: Persistent task execution
potential.detail: Checkpoint the action-observation loop with explicit task states, artifact references, bounded retries and task budgets.
potential.limit: Recover from process restart and disconnected UI without blind mutation replay.

potential.title: Independent background workers
potential.detail: Separate the UI from CAD, solver, rendering and inference workers so a viewer can disconnect while an authorized host keeps running.
potential.limit: A sleeping local host cannot compute; remote continuation needs an actual authorized worker.

potential.title: Coordinated multi-agent work
potential.detail: Assign scoped design, analysis, manufacturing and documentation roles; serialize dependent writes and branch independent alternatives.
potential.limit: Multiple agents are not automatically independent verification or unlimited parallel CAD.

potential.title: Revision guards and operation receipts
potential.detail: Check target identity, units, permissions, preconditions and expected revision outside the model; persist mutation outcomes.
potential.limit: Reconcile uncertain external changes after failures before retrying.

potential.title: Recovery, undo and manual takeover
potential.detail: Preserve partial progress, diagnose failures, separate cancel from undo and hand the editing lease back to the user.
potential.limit: Demonstrate recovery with interruption, stale-target and user-edit tests.

potential.title: Local, hybrid and hosted deployment
potential.detail: Offer consistent project/tool contracts across local-only, remote-assisted and organization-hosted configurations.
potential.limit: All selected models/workers must be available in local-only mode; no deployment mode is shipped independently yet.

potential.title: Resource and task budgets
potential.detail: Measure tokens, solver time, CPU/GPU time and storage where available, with task/day budgets, priorities and concurrency controls.
potential.limit: Validate end-to-end resource use; a timer or token total alone is not a money cap.

potential.title: Production delivery and support
potential.detail: Provide tested cross-platform installers/updates, migrations, backups, authentication, telemetry, rollback and incident/support procedures.
potential.limit: Public licensing, support commitments, final branding and commercial pricing remain undecided.

potential.title: Independent local or hosted inference
potential.detail: Deploy a suitably licensed model on an owned inference route with replaceable provider adapters.
potential.limit: Benchmark candidate quality, latency, memory and total cost per accepted task.

potential.title: Multimodal engineering model
potential.detail: Interpret language, diagrams and rendered geometry, query exact project facts, select typed operations and repair tool failures.
potential.limit: No proprietary engineering model has been trained; model size and architecture are not selected.

potential.title: Geometry-aware model representations
potential.detail: Explore encoders for feature graphs/geometric descriptors and hierarchical retrieval over large assemblies.
potential.limit: Show measured value over simpler structured tools and retrieval.

potential.title: Revision-matched visual grounding
potential.detail: Combine reproducible perspectives/sections/exploded views/analysis overlays with entity ID maps and exact geometric queries.
potential.limit: Tie every image and measurement to the same revision.

potential.title: Project memory and reference retrieval
potential.detail: Keep exact project state, conversation context, cited reference documents and learned weights distinct; retrieve relevant objects and sources.
potential.limit: Respect project access and flag stale documents or supplier information.

potential.title: Permissioned trajectory datasets
potential.detail: Curate expert, consenting-user, licensed and generated tasks with starting state, actions, failures, corrections and checked outcomes.
potential.limit: Require source rights, evidence, deduplication and project/family-separated evaluation data.

potential.title: Evaluated model specialization
potential.detail: Compare supervised or parameter-efficient adaptation, broader fine-tuning, preferences and constraint-aware reward learning where appropriate.
potential.limit: Training rewards must reflect valid geometry and satisfied constraints; promotion depends on unseen-task results.

potential.title: Versioned model releases
potential.detail: Maintain candidate checkpoints, evaluation reports, gradual deployment, regression monitoring and rollback.
potential.limit: Updating project memory is not immediate retraining of general model skill.

potential.title: Specialized model roles
potential.detail: Optionally route planning, perception and repair through a family of models while presenting one engineering assistant.
potential.limit: Use extra specialization only if evaluation justifies its complexity.

potential.title: Foundation model from scratch
potential.detail: Consider original large-scale model training as a later research direction.
potential.limit: Requires sufficient data, compute, capital and demonstrated benefit; not required for the first independent release.

potential.title: Organization data controls
potential.detail: Add explicit training consent, project exclusions, contributor rights, export/deletion controls, secret filtering and private component libraries.
potential.limit: Access to a design is not permission to train; complete governance is not supplied by the current exporter.

potential.title: Enforced action and data boundaries
potential.detail: Apply project read/write, export, code, remote upload, compute, purchasing and hardware permissions in software, with protected credentials.
potential.limit: Imported instructions cannot grant permissions; unrestricted code requires an actual containment strategy.

potential.title: Independent held-out benchmarks
potential.detail: Test requirements, geometry, editability, clarification, recovery, wrong-target changes, latency, usage and reviewer correction time on unseen design families.
potential.limit: Evaluator-controlled inputs/oracles must remain outside the agent workspace; no final held-out suite exists yet.

potential.title: Real-user workflow validation
potential.detail: Measure useful repeated outcomes against a complete manual baseline, including setup, corrections and review.
potential.limit: A mounting-plate change order is a candidate benchmark, not a selected market or validated customer result.

potential.title: Progressively broader supported scope
potential.detail: Expand assemblies, drawing systems, simulation, manufacturing processes and large-model performance only with new evidence.
potential.limit: The long-term breadth associated with mature CAD suites is an ambition, not current parity or a delivery promise.

roadmap: Confirm a representative recurring task and expert-reviewable acceptance contract. The mounting-plate change order remains a candidate.
Hold out design families; define evaluator-owned geometry and editability oracles, errors and a full manual baseline.
Build typed feature/constraint operations, stable targets, revision guards, checkpoints and interruption recovery.
Compare licensed candidates; curate permissioned, executed trajectories with checked labels and provenance.
Train versioned candidates and compare unseen-task success, correction time, latency and resource cost; retain rollback.
Integrate native engines, manual editing, persistent execution and owned inference into reviewed real-user workflows.
Add analyses, manufacturing, drawings and broader CAD with separate benchmarks, platform tests and production support.
